mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate, below 0.25%, signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the average 20-day return is not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the risk of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 750,000 units signals weakening consumer demand and residential investment, which reduces confidence in economic growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 750.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 97.0 index points indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals a contraction in real output and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 97.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of joint decline instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate combined with stagnant inflation (CPIAUCSL below 2.0%) signals a premature tightening cycle that increases real interest rates without inflation support, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 8.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls below 133,000 thousand signals a labor market collapse, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of joint trigger instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 400,000 million dollars, combined with a drop in industrial production below 97.0, indicates a deepening demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS < 400000.0 and INDPRO < 97.0, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
